title: The Dark Truth About Heavenly Delusion (TV series) #Shorts
description:
Reproduction explains more of Heavenly Delusion (TV series) than any philosophy dares to admit. Heavenly Delusion (Japanese: 天国大魔境, Hepburn: Tengoku Daimakyō; lit. 'Heaven Grand Makyō') is a Japanese anime television series based on Masakazu Ishiguro's manga series Heavenly Delusion. The series was produced by Production I.G and directed by Hirotaka Mori.

Heavenly Delusion (TV series) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Heavenly Delusion won the overall "Spring 2023 Anime Awards" in the Anime Trending Spring 2023 awards. With this award, the series secured an Anime of the Year nomination.
